subject: Decision Making
title: Diverse Teams Decide Better
description: Learn Diverse Teams Decide Better in one minute.

hook.text: Diverse teams make better decisions than homogeneous expert teams. Different backgrounds bring different information.

buildup.text: Financial analysts in ethnically diverse teams priced stocks more accurately than homogeneous groups.

discovery.text: Diversity works by increasing cognitive friction. Disagreement forces deeper analysis and prevents easy consensus.

twist.text: Diverse Teams Decide Better shows that the best decision is often not the most intuitive one.

climax.text: Comfort is not a good proxy for quality. The friction of diversity produces better outcomes even when it feels harder.

punchline.text: Uncomfortable but accurate. Diversity produces friction that improves group.

quiz.question: Why do diverse teams make better decisions?
options: Different backgrounds create cognitive friction that forces deeper analysis
